Deployment-target performance matrix

Campaign evidence across physical devices, simulators, browsers, and native shells, with commit provenance on every measurement.

9/11 targets captured34/44 modes captured49 actions compared1164 action rows at measured commit

6961e50b685d441e88b37d20d3f38a27136572fb is the measured product commit. Each target keeps separate portrait/landscape and light/dark measurements. Focused captures, when present, replace only matching actions inside one mode. Physical-iPad web remains the calibrated release gate and is explicitly unavailable in this campaign.

Normalized results JSONDetailed narrativeSource manifest

Capture limitations

Constraints retained with the evidence
  • All product measurements use 6961e50b685d441e88b37d20d3f38a27136572fb; later commits change only performance harnesses and report generation.
  • Physical iPad web and native are P1/unmeasured because iOS 26 XCUITest requires a root-owned RemoteXPC tunnel that could not be started without an administrator credential.
  • iPad simulator native actions and landscape drawing are P1/unmeasured: the simulator Settings surface does not expose the persisted rotation-lock control required by ADR-0090. No external rotation or profiling-only preference seam was used.
  • Android physical and emulator landscape action sweeps are P1/unmeasured after repeated Settings-navigation timeouts. Valid drawing and undo evidence for those modes is retained.
  • Resolved campaign-harness P1s: desktop coloring scroll was changed to a trusted wheel path, the WebKit coloring-page readiness race was fixed, and Appium 3 borrowed screen/action sessions were made W3C-safe with explicit provenance. Exact post-fix retries completed; no product result was rerun merely to turn a valid red gate green.
  • Two Firefox action waits failed once at different labels and passed their exact retries, so they are retained as transient incidents rather than repeated P1s.
  • Firefox drawing is unmeasured because the real-screen frame runner supports Chromium and WebKit only. Standalone Mac undo-scenario captures are advisory and lack the per-mode metadata required by this matrix.
  • Desktop captures used exact 1512×982 or 982×1512 CSS viewports at DPR 2. The headed landscape browser window exceeded the physical display height at 100% browser zoom, but Playwright retained the requested page viewport.
  • Simulator, desktop, native-shell, and automated Android results are advisory. Physical iPad web is the only Safari-calibrated release-gate transport, and it was unavailable in this campaign.
  • Raw perf-profiles remain local scratch evidence; sources.json preserves their ordered provenance and data.json contains the committed normalized results.
  • 34 cells carry results preserved from data.json rather than re-read raw captures: The 2026-08-20 campaign wrote its raw captures to gitignored perf-profiles scratch, and that scratch is no longer on the workstation, so those cells cannot be re-read from raw input. Their normalized results are carried forward from the published report rather than recaptured, which would replace a first valid result — including a red gate — with a different number. How to read this snapshot

Drawing dots show the median P95/P99 and worst maximum across repeated blank-paper runs in one target mode. Raw drawing tables and action samples are re-scored with the current metric definitions. The committed JSON preserves every renderer phase, target mode, source commit, and raw source path.

Action sources are applied in manifest order inside one mode. A focused capture replaces only its declared labels in that mode; all other labels retain their earlier measurement and provenance. Profiling controls such as the idle-frame sample remain in normalized data but are omitted from the user-action comparison.
